description: This file is a Python source script that sets up and runs a pipeline-based voice bot, utilizing transport mechanisms, TTS services, and asynchronous event handling.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents a sequence of processing steps in the pipeline, including TTS and transport output.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline and its execution parameters, managing frame queuing and timeout.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Controls the execution of pipeline tasks, handling signals and asynchronous execution.

classes.name: RunnerArguments
classes.description: Contains configuration parameters for running the pipeline, such as timeouts and signal handling.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract class defining transport interface for communication channels.

classes.name: TTSSpeakFrame
classes.description: Represents a frame of audio data for speech synthesis output.

classes.name: EndFrame
classes.description: Signals the end of an audio stream or message in the pipeline.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes and runs the bot with specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point, setting up transport and starting the bot asynchronously.
